thread:
Eli: Heads-up — two customer asks landed (FastForms + HealthEdge) asking for an 'Optimize Advisor' that suggests batching/caching/quant profiles and fires eval-triggered alerts. Need to decide realistic scope for next sprint. 

Eli: TL;DR proposal: v0 = read-only recommender + eval-alerting hooks; v1 = ops-facing prescriptive suggestions (apply changes) behind a canary. Agree/disagree? :thinking_face:

Priya: Need concrete launch gates. My proposed acceptance criteria for v0: 
- recommendation accuracy: at least 3/5 sampled prompts show cost or latency improvement w/o quality regression (manual check)
- eval-alerting: alerts trigger on concordance < 0.92 or BLEU drop > 5% for relevant eval sets
- perf: p95 generation latency for short-chat (<=128 tokens) must stay < 200ms on hosted tier when recommendations are applied as a suggestion (i.e., no auto-apply)

Jonah: +1 to v0 read-only. Notes from infra: quantization options differ by architecture — we can offer two recommendation tiers: 
- "safe": int8 post-training (low risk, lower mem wins)
- "aggressive": int4 / QAT suggestions (higher win but needs per-model validation)
We should tag recs with a risk score and show expected memory/latency delta.

Marta: Customer nuance: FastForms is throughput-driven and ok testing aggressive recs in a pilot. HealthEdge requires conservative ops (audits + KMS). Suggest pilot FastForms first, HealthEdge later after audit checklist.

Priya: For eval-triggered alerts: proposing signal list -> 
- concordance on seeded promptset (per-customer)
- crest-to-cost ratio (tokens-per-infer * successful-responses)
- anomaly in latency distribution (p99 spike > 2x baseline)
Alert behavior: email + Slack channel + ops ticket creation. Example rule: 
```
when concordance < 0.92 for 3 consecutive eval windows (1h) -> alert: eval-fallout
```
Jonah: Implementation notes: batching suggestions depend on request shape (seq len histogram). We should expose a simple DSL in the advisor output: 
```
batch_hint: {
  max_batch_tokens: 8192,
  preferred_batch_size: 8,
  pad_strategy: "dynamic"
}
```
We will produce recommended quant profile string and a conservative fallback in case inference artifacts appear.

Eli: Love the DSL idea. Priya — can we make the eval sets per-customer editable in console? HealthEdge will want to add PII-sensitive prompts and require audit trail.

Priya: Yes, console edit + audit log. We'll add a checkbox for 'sensitive' eval set which requires manual approval to use for auto-apply in future. For v0 it will only be used to trigger alerts.

Marta: Prioritization: I recommend scoring features by customer impact (active requests), implementation cost (eng weeks), and risk. Quick scoring: 
- Read-only advisor + alerts: impact high (customers asked) / cost med (3-4w) / risk low -> Priority A
- Auto-apply adjustments: impact high / cost high (6-8w) / risk med -> Priority B
- Aggressive quant autosuggests (int4/QAT): impact med / cost high / risk high -> Priority C

Jonah: One more technical constraint: KV-cache interaction with quantized kernels can cause small quality drift in very long-chat cases; add a warning for seq-length > 1024.

Eli: Ok locking scope for next sprint (sprint start +2): 
- Ship v0: read-only advisor (batching + caching hints + quant profile recommendations) + eval-triggered alerts only (no auto-apply).
- Pilot: FastForms only; HealthEdge onboarding plan in parallel.
- Acceptance gates: Priya's acceptance criteria + sample pilot dashboard with 10 recs validated.

Priya: Owners: Priya (PM), Jonah (eng lead), Marta (customer liaison). Delivery checklist: 
1) Advisor output schema + DSL doc
2) Console UI for eval-sets + audit flags
3) Alert rules + templated Slack/email messages
4) Pilot onboarding playbook for FastForms

Jonah: I'll create an RFC for the advisor schema + include example outputs (safe/aggressive) and memory/latency deltas. ETA: EOW for RFC, dev spike next sprint.

DevBot: runbook created -> /runbooks/optimize-advisor-v0 (auto). :white_check_mark:

Marta: I'll schedule FastForms kickoff for Tue and draft the audit checklist for HealthEdge.

Eli: Great. If no objections by EOD I'll lock the sprint card and add the acceptance criteria. :+1:
